entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Akechi did WHAT!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He turned himself in to the police.[n]Sis told me yesterday.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He's admitted to being the perpetrator[n]behind the recent cases.
That's right.
And he's doing the right thing...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So he's alive...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Akechi-kun survived and owned up[n]to what he did...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Well, I feel it's for the best.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If Akechi-kun is alive, and he can atone[n]for his crimes... that's not a bad turn of[n]events.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't that all stuff to be happy about?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mmhm.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's Christmas. We should enjoy the day[n]to our hearts' content.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I approve. Let everyone be merry to[n]the max!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'm the one who should be giving[n]permission, you know.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, as long as you don't go overboard,[n]I guess you can go ahead and cut loose[n]today.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell yeah! Merry Christmas!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...He didn't hear a word of that.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Eh, fine.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Oh my! This is quite the sight.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...I'm going to be entirely honest: I wasn't[n]able to bring a dish.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Instead, leave the dishwashing duties[n]to me. I'll make sure they turn out[n]beautifully immaculate.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hmm... Why don't we all just clean up[n]together?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, who brought what?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I brought that marinated seafood.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Mmm! That's super good!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It may not be to everyone's tastes, but[n]I brought that cheese plate.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It smells like dirty socks...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ohhh! But it tastes great!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank goodness.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, is this a croquembouche? It's so cute!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I made that all by myself!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All I did was buy some cream puffs[n]and stack them up, though.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's been arranged so artistically that[n]I hesitate to sample it. When it comes[n]to sweets, Ann truly has us beat.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But then, who brought this box over here?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ooh, this looks like more sweets. Not[n]mine, by the way.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uhhh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Me... kinda?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ryuji... brought sweets...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ryuji and sweets...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sweets...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey! What're you guys gettin' at?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It was just a bit unexpected, is all.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I had expected something along the lines[n]of meat... For some reason, chicken comes[n]to mind when I think of you.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ryuji... Chicken...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: U-Um, I'm sorry! I didn't mean that in[n]any sort of comparative way.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Please, don't keep going... It just hurts[n]even more...
Cheer up.
You're not chicken at all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Did you hear what I just said?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: C'mon, don't get all depressed.[n]Everyone's here to party!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Everyone...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mona-chan...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was trying my best not to mention it,[n]but it's hard to avoid.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If only Mona could be here with us...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Someone call for me?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, we were just talkin' about—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: HUH!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait... What? No way! I thought you[n]disappeared!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like the only me that disappeared[n]was the one in the Metaverse.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So... you stayed in reality as a cat?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: When I woke up, I was out in Shibuya[n]looking like this.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I headed back here right away, but it[n]took a surprising amount of time.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If you were coming back here, you[n]should've told us, moron!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We were so worried!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Sheesh... Well, I've brought my own[n]surprise back too.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I brought some fried chicken. This[n]doesn't have anything to do with[n]your conversation earlier, though.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Any room left on the table?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oooh! Now there's our chief for ya!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Talk about everything falling into place...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: C'mon, let's get started! We're gonna[n]party to celebrate our hard work and[n]my grand return!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't push your luck!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Things are finally back to normal.
Yeah.
Now everyone really is here.
